narrative:
Sylvania municipal court district has 59,453 registered voters, with 54.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 21.4% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 23.8%, a modest Democratic lean of 2.4 percentage points. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean +3.7% D−R vs -0.5% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
